text: Partners must never see another partner's claims -- through the portal or the API. That's REQ-3, and this lesson plans how to actually hold that line.
The rule: a claim's partner_company has to match the logged-in user's own company. That's the row-level ACL Zara and Dmitri are planning.
The harder part: that rule has to hold wherever this data can be reached -- the portal, reports, and any future way of reaching the table -- not just the obvious path.
The literal ACL script is lesson 9. How the planned API will respect this same rule is a question for whoever builds it.
Next: planning the routing automation, the API's shape, and the testing strategy that has to clear before any of this goes live.
